description: The Hughes Crypto Engine (HCE) for Hughes HN and HX systems enables end-to-end bidirectional encryption between a remote site and the enterprise data center, while still allowing the use of satellite acceleration and other HN and HX features. The HCE uses AES for encryption and IKE to auto-generate and refresh session keys.
